separate_audio_file: separate an audio file into stems using the demucs Separator class with a pretrained model
separate_tensor: separate a torch tensor waveform into individual stems using the demucs Separator class
list_models: list all available pretrained demucs models from a local repo or remote source
update_parameter: update separation parameters like device, shifts, overlap, and segment on an existing Separator instance
load_audio: load an audio file from disk into a torch tensor using ffmpeg or torchaudio backends
